full_prompt_en: A square grisaille painting presents a large upward-turned face built from overlapping gray planes against a textured monochrome background. The face occupies nearly the full frame, with the cropped hairline and forehead close to the top edge and the chin reaching the lower right. The head tilts back slightly and turns toward the right, its eyes looking beneath dark brows into the upper distance. A strong cheekbone, long nose, parted lips, and angular jaw are modeled with blocks of charcoal, slate, ash gray, and pale cream-white. The left side of the face is partly swallowed by a deep shadowed mass, while the right cheek and bridge of the nose catch broad bright patches. Behind the head, rough rectangles, smudged brush marks, and faint architectural-looking fragments overlap without resolving into a specific setting. Near the upper left, a pale broken vertical band interrupts the dark background, and the upper right carries a lighter gray field. The lower edge contains a dark collar-like shape that grounds the otherwise close facial study. Light appears to come from the upper right, striking protruding planes and letting the recessed eye sockets and underside of the chin turn almost black. Paint is visibly layered and scraped, so the tonal transitions shift between firm geometric facets and soft rubbed passages. The composition leaves little empty space, making the rising gaze and changing planes of gray the central event. The overall image is monumental and restrained, using only black, white, and many grays to create sculptural volume and contemplative tension.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形灰色画法作品呈现一张大幅仰起的面孔，由交叠的灰色平面构成，身后是有肌理的单色背景。面孔几乎占满全幅，裁切的发际与前额贴近顶边，下巴伸向右下方。头略后仰并转向右边，眼睛从深眉下望向高处。突出颧骨、长鼻、微张的嘴唇和棱角下颌由炭灰、石板灰、灰白与浅奶油白色块塑成。面部左侧部分被深影吞没，右脸颊和鼻梁则接住宽阔亮斑。头后粗糙矩形、擦抹笔痕和隐约似建筑的碎片交叠，却没有形成具体场所。左上附近一道浅色断续竖带打断暗背景，右上是一片更浅灰色域。下边缘有一道深色似衣领形，让紧凑面部习作得以落定。光似乎来自右上，打在突出的面上，使凹陷眼窝和下巴底部转为近黑。颜料明显层叠并经刮擦，因此调子过渡在坚实几何切面和柔和擦揉区域间转换。构图几乎不留空处，让上望目光与不断变化的灰色面成为核心。整体图像宏大而克制，只用黑、白和众多灰阶创造雕塑体积与沉思张力。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome painting builds volume from layered gray facets, scraped paint, and soft rubbed transitions. Near-black recesses meet broad chalky white planes, with slate and ash values bridging the extremes. Edges alternate between chiseled geometric cuts and dissolving scumbles, making the surface feel both sculpted and worked by hand. Directional light selects upper-facing planes and leaves lower overlaps deep. Background fragments echo the focal geometry without becoming a detailed setting. A close crop and restrained palette make tonal structure, texture, and weight the whole visual argument.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色绘画由层叠灰色切面、刮擦颜料和柔和擦揉过渡建立体积。近黑凹处遇到宽阔的粉白平面，石板灰与灰白值连接两端。边缘在凿刻般的几何裁口和消散的擦涂间交替，让表面同时像被雕塑又有手工加工痕迹。定向光选择朝上的平面，下层交叠保持深暗。背景碎片呼应焦点几何，却不变成细致场所。紧凑裁切和克制色域让明暗结构、肌理和重量成为全部视觉论点。
theme_en: A monumental upturned face painted in layered shades of gray
theme_zh: 一张以层叠灰阶绘成、向上仰起的巨大面孔
name: Grisaille
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
